title: adaptive-capacity-harmonizer-and-fallback-inspector-hotfix
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: We observed a multi-region incident where aggressive rejoin behavior and aggressive failback caused repeated oscillations of traffic between regions. This triggered SLO thrashing and higher tail latency for customers routed through small-capacity regions. This hotfix introduces two coordinated mechanisms: an adaptive capacity harmonizer (server-side quota reservoir + per-region rejoin damping) and a sticky fallback inspector (diagnostics + short-term sticky fallback policy) to prevent rapid oscillation during regional recovery windows. Summary of changes: implement quota reservoir to reserve a tiny emergency budget when a region reports healthy but not yet warmed KV caches; add rejoin damping (cooldown fence + exponential rejoin backoff) to the node lifecycle; expose fallback-inspector endpoint for on-call debugging and live decisions; wire new metrics (fallback.harmonizer.*, fallback.inspector.*) and add tracing spans for decision points; add unit/integration tests, a small docs incident writeup, and a canary rollout config. This PR is a targeted hotfix intended to stabilize regional failover behavior while we work on a longer-term scheduler rewrite. The change is runtime-only and non-breaking for customer APIs. See linked Linear ticket ENG-4218 for design notes and postmortem rationale.

Priya Nair: Thanks Ethan, updated variable name and added inline math comment. Also added a short unit test that asserts the decay curve (fallback_hysteresis_test.go).

Marisol Vega: Question: how do we ensure we don't permanently starve small customers in a region with frequent brief outages? Please add a per-customer minimum allocation and a test that covers churn scenarios.
Priya Nair: Added per-customer floor of 1 token and a churn simulation integration test. Documented trade-offs in the incident doc.

Jonah Klein: Approving. Observability is in place and the inspector endpoint returns a compact JSON with reservoir state and recent rejoin timestamps. Recommend squash-merge and immediate canary to the 'staging-eu' pool.

release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize regional failover by adding an adaptive capacity harmonizer (reservoir) and rejoin damping; add a fallback-inspector admin endpoint for diagnostics. Reduces failover oscillation and tail latency during region recoveries. No customer API changes.
